notes.title: Version 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h3]Awards:[/h3]
Realm Makers Interactive Fiction: We are proud to see The Reluctant Redemption of Verity Lux be selected as a finalist in the Realm Makers Interactive Fiction category for 2025. Congratulations Amy, Sammi, Chris, and Megumi!

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Where's Walker Mini-game: A new mini-game for the players who get all the way to the end, collecting all the clues along the way, to answer once and for all the question that starts Verity's investigation.
[*] Poetry in Gallery: Added to the gallery is the collection of mysterious poetry that Verity has been collecting along the path of her manhunt.
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New spirits: Several new and improved spirits are now visible in various Hidden Object games and the location gallery once the player unlocks this extra power of her PDA.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor updates and improvements across the whole game.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gallery Locations: The gallery now allows Verity to revisit the locations she has discovered to see the lovely artwork and revisit world building details.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Hidden Object Game: This update continues to add new and improved quality of life features to the hidden object portion of the game including UI/UX improvements, labeling, and functionality.
[*] Improved location parallax: Some previously 'flat' locations are now properly layered and dynamically parallax. More to come in future updates!  
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor updates and improvements across the whole game. 
[/list]

Enjoy!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[*] Improved Hidden Object Game: This update adds several new quality of life features to the hidden object portion of the game including UI/UX improvements, labeling, and functionality.
[*] Improved location parallax: Several previously 'flat' locations are now properly layered and demonstrate dynamic parallax effect. More to come in future updates!  
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor updates and improvements across the whole game.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Gallery Feature: Now you can take a look at all the people, places, and clues you've encountered in the game as well as seeing what you're missing...
[*] Improved Player Analytics: We’ve been steadily updating our play through analytics to help us understand how you play, and how we can make the game better.
(Note: The feature can be enabled or disabled in game settings but we hope you’ll leave it on to help us make the game better for everyone.)
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced file size: This update optimizes some of the game assets for a faster download and smaller install size on your device.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor updates and improvements across the whole game. 
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New and Improved Story Map: Replaced the previous checkpoint system with a new, robust Story Node Map that now allows users to visually map out all episodes and story segments, load previous branches and ensure they don’t miss anything!
(Note: Players with older saves will not see all past progress reflected in the new map until story nodes are visited again.)
[*] Player Analytics: We’ve added optional, anonymized play-through and progression analytics to help us understand how you play, and how we can make the game better. The feature can be enabled or disabled in game settings but we hope you’ll leave it on to make the game better for everyone.
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Better Story: This update fixes a few minor plot holes, game-logic problems, and inconsistencies as well as improving clarity on several others.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Several updates and fixes across the whole game. 
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Ladies, Gentlemen, Androids and Others: The first chapter of [i]The Reluctant Redemption of Verity Lux[/i] is available [b]now[/b] for your previewing pleasure. With Next Fest just on the horizon, we welcome you to hop in and take a look around. We are quite proud of the story we have for you and are eager to hear your thoughts. 

Start your journey as Verity Lux, ace reporter for Rosetta North, and start digging into the unexpectedly complex life of our missing celebrity playboy, Walker Khamenos. 
[list]
[*]Explore the first three leads today, and for astute investigators, a secret fourth lead.
[*]Get a taste of the beautiful, though corrupt, world of Ptah
[*]Meet our unhinged cast of characters
[*]Report your finding to the world with the spin of your choosing
[*]Or simply soak in the jaunty music and ambiance of your favorite setting
[/list]

We've made story completion easier then ever with a checkpoint system that allows you to easily jump back in time and replay segments until you are happy with your results. The demo also comes equipped with a robust bug reporting and feedback submission system that you can use to contact us without even leaving the game. So feel free to throw anything you find our way, and we'll be sure to polish it up to sparkling as soon as is feasibly possible. 

Thank you so much for following us on this journey! Catch you on the next post.
-Soma Games Team
